div.span: ZkDVP Internal Components
ZkDVP Atomic Swap Flow
Phase 1: Preparation
Phase 2: Proof Generation
Phase 3: ZkDVP Processing
Phase 4: Atomic Execution
Phase 5: Completion

Enygma Merkle Tree
- Track commitments
- Verify ownership
- Prevent double-spend

ERC721 Merkle Tree
- Track commitments
- Verify ownership
- Prevent double-spend

JoinSplit Verifier
- Validate Enygma proofs
- Check public signals
- Groth16 verification

Ownership Verifier
- Validate NFT proofs
- Check commitment
- Verify nullifier
User A receives ERC721 NFT
User B receives Enygma Tokens

Execute Atomic Swap
1. Nullify old commitments
2. Transfer Enygma → User B
3. Transfer NFT → User A
4. Update Merkle trees
5. Emit events
ZkDVP Contract

Validate Proof A
✓ Ownership verification
✓ Merkle root check
✓ Nullifier uniqueness

Validate Proof B
✓ Ownership verification
✓ Merkle root check
✓ Nullifier uniqueness

Cross-Validation
✓ Swap compatibility
✓ Message matching
✓ Atomic conditions

Generate ZK Proof A
- Ownership of Enygma
- Commitment to swap
- Valid parameters

Generate ZK Proof B
- Ownership of NFT
- Commitment to swap
- Valid parameters
